findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_products" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search the public InkFE print catalog by free text. Use this when the buyer wants something other than a business card, or to confirm a product exists before ca…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products, get_product, list_business_card_templates, create_business_card_design · Private data: approve_design_proof, create_business_card_design, create_checkout, start_guest_session, revoke_guest_session · Public sink: list_business_card_templates, create_checkout · Destructive: revoke_guest_session.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products, get_product, list_business_card_templates, create_business_card_design · Private data: approve_design_proof, create_business_card_design, create_checkout, start_guest_session, revoke_guest_session · Public sink: list_business_card_templates, create_checkout · Destructive: revoke_guest_session

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
